original_value: 34-inch ultrawide curved OLED monitor built for immersive gaming and creative work, featuring 3440x1440 resolution, 175Hz refresh rate, HDR support, USB-C input with 90W power delivery, and an adjustable stand. The display uses an anti-glare panel with wide color gamut coverage and integrated KVM switching for dual-device setups.
